description: Microne ME6211C33 — 3.3V fixed LDO, 500mA output, ultra-low dropout ~100mV at 100mA, low quiescent current ~40µA. SOT-23-5 package. Good middle-ground between XC6206 (200mA) and AP2112K (600mA).
name: me6211c33
watch_out_for: 6V max input. Ceramic-stable: 1uF in/out. 500mA class; thermals limit sustained current in SOT-23-5.
